svg.aria-label: Tomedown Obsidian guide 02 — the book file with Preserve: global on: the tagged heading you can rename, two blank lines of room under it, your own lines above the begin marker, the marker and its hash, the generated block between the markers, the reading view where the comments disappear, and the settings toggle
